wizard.perm_mic_denied_body:
Microphone access was previously denied.

System Settings will open. Find Click-n-speak under Microphone and toggle it ON.
wizard.perm_mic_first_body:
Click-n-speak needs to hear your speech.

Click «Request Access» — macOS will show a permission dialog. Click Allow.
wizard.perm_mic_not_granted_body:
Microphone access was not granted. You can enable it later in:
  System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone

Open System Settings to enable it now?
wizard.perm_mic_granted_body: Done! Click-n-speak can now hear your speech.
wizard.perm_access_body:
Accessibility lets Click-n-speak type transcribed text into any app.

Click «Open Settings» — System Settings will open on the Accessibility page.

  1. Find Click-n-speak in the list
  2. Toggle it ON
  3. Come back here — this dialog closes automatically.
wizard.perm_access_granted_body: Accessibility access confirmed. Text injection is now active.
wizard.perm_input_body:
Input Monitoring lets Click-n-speak detect the global hotkey (Alt+Space).

macOS should be showing a permission dialog right now — click Allow in it.

If no dialog appeared (permission was previously denied), click «Open Settings» to enable it manually.
wizard.perm_input_granted_body: Input Monitoring confirmed. The Alt+Space hotkey is now active.
wizard.all_set_body:
All permissions are granted.

Click-n-speak needs to restart once to activate the global hotkey (Alt+Space). After the restart, everything will work immediately.
